newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts airline profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts airline profit outlook.

text.p: Lehman said revenue weakness will sharply cut into profits at Delta Air Lines Inc, Northwest Airlines Corp, and Trans World Airlines Inc in the second calendar quarter of 1997.
-- Analyst Brian Harris said he expects Delta to earn $3.85 a share in the period -- Delta's fourth quarter -- down from his prior estimate of $4.15.
-- He said Delta's traffic has been slightly stronger than expected but yields have been weaker.

-- In a research report, he cut his estimate of Northwest's second quarter earnings to $1.05 from $1.60, reflecting recent labor agreements, weak Pacific revenues, and a $30 million charge related to currency hedging.
-- He cut TWA's Q2 profit estimate to $0.05 from $0.40. Shares lost 7/16 to 9-3/16 early in the session.
-- Harris said other quarterly estimates for other airlines remain intact and said most of his estimates are below consenses, reflecting tough excise tax comparisons.
